merge_weight_coverage: LoRA-adapted linear matrices only; unadapted parameters (embeddings, norms, lm_head) are NOT covered by this check and the verdict must concede that
merge_weight_resolution_note: gated on the ELEMENT-WISE MAXIMUM deviation in literal bf16 ULP spacing of the ideal merged value, with the exceedance fraction reported alongside. A fraction-only gate was rejected by review #20: at 1e-6 of 3.6e9 elements it permitted 3,633 arbitrarily erroneous elements, and a single corrupted weight PASSED while being detected. The max has no such blind spot. Non-finite merged weights are counted separately and gated at zero, because `NaN > 2` is False and would otherwise vanish from the count. Covers LoRA-adapted matrices ONLY; unadapted parameters (embeddings, norms, output head) are not checked.
equivalence_basis: teacher-forced per-position top-1 agreement over the assistant span (the scored surface): the token sequence is fixed, so it is not subject to decoding chaos and it is sensitive to a change anywhere in the continuation. loss_delta is a second, distributional line of evidence. Free-running generation statistics are reported only, because they measure amplification rather than equivalence.
